title: Name-Change Grace Nights at Cut-Off — Group Room Blocks
content:
**Rider.** At the cut-off release of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block, name-change grace nights count as reserved in addition to the Group Block Rate nights. The grace covers the nights of the organiser's cancelled Group Block Rate reservations naming the block and follows how far the block's arrival still is, in calendar days, against the block type's rooming-list name-change period:

- arrival at least the name-change period **plus 7** calendar days away: **all** those nights count as reserved;
- arrival at least the name-change period away but fewer than that: **0.5** (one half) of them count, rounded down;
- arrival fewer days away than the name-change period: none count.

**Records read.** The organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand cancelled, with their nights.

### Bands for the rooming-list block types

| Block type | Name-change period (days before arrival) | All nights count when arrival is | Half count when arrival is | None count when arrival is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sports Team Room Block | 2 | 9 days or more away | 2 to 8 days away | fewer than 2 days away |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 7 | 14 days or more away | 7 to 13 days away | fewer than 7 days away |

### Worked grace (hypothetical Tour & Travel Series Block with 9 cancelled Group Block Rate nights naming it)

| Arrival still | Grace nights counted as reserved |
|---|---|
| 14 days away | 9 |
| 10 days away | 4 (one half of 9 is 4.5, rounded down) |
| 6 days away | 0 |
